result.description:
Full-time Drainer (Leading Hand) position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Halls Head, WA 6210.   

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
-	Full-Time Drainer (Leading Hand).
-	$80,000 - $110,000 p.a. plus superannuation
-	Work in a professional environment.
-	Be part of a great team!

South Coast Civil (WA) Pty Ltd is a Western Australian civil construction company specialising in earthmoving, excavation, trenching, site preparation and underground drainage works across residential, commercial and infrastructure projects. The company operates a modern fleet of excavators, dozers, loaders and other civil construction machinery. 
On behalf of South Coast Civil (WA), we are looking for an experienced Drainer (Leading Hand) for a full-time position based in Halls Head WA 6210, with work undertaken across the company’s project sites.

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Interpret construction drawings, specifications and site plans to determine drainage layouts, levels, materials and installation requirements. 
•	Plan daily drainage activities, allocate labour and plant, and coordinate drainage and earthworks crews to ensure efficient project delivery. 
•	Set out drainage works using laser levels, string lines and other levelling equipment, checking trench depths, grades, alignments and slopes against project requirements. 
•	Install, maintain and repair below-ground drainage systems, including stormwater, sanitary and sewer pipework, pits, manholes, culverts, headwalls and associated infrastructure. 
•	Prepare trenches, bedding and foundations, and sling, guide, position, joint and secure pipes and culverts safely and accurately. 
•	Supervise and actively participate in drainage works, providing practical direction to crew members, operators and subcontractors throughout job execution. 
•	Coordinate excavation, pipe installation, backfilling, compaction, concrete works and site reinstatement. 
•	Monitor workmanship and complete quality checks to ensure drainage installations comply with drawings, specifications and applicable standards. 
•	Inspect existing drainage systems, diagnose faults and undertake or recommend appropriate repairs, maintenance or upgrades. 
•	Ensure works are completed in accordance with health, safety, environmental and quality requirements, including conducting pre-start briefings and addressing site hazards. 
•	Operate excavators, loaders, rollers and other machinery when appropriately licensed and required. 
•	Maintain daily site records and report progress, delays, safety issues, quality concerns, plant requirements and material shortages to management.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant drainage, plumbing or civil construction trade qualification, or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	At least of one-year work experience as a drainer.
•	Strong knowledge of drainage grades, levels, pipe alignments, trench preparation and installation methods.
•	Ability to interpret civil construction drawings, drainage plans and technical specifications. 
•	Demonstrated ability to lead drainage or earthworks crews while remaining actively involved in hands-on-work.
•	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety, quality control and environmental requirements.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $80,000 - $110,000, plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week. 

Code: CLAR0020
